name: temu-mcp
description: Temu (ecommerce channels): me, list_orders, set_inventory, end_listing. Every tool maps to a documen

platform_mcp_temu_app_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TEMU_APP_KEY
platform_mcp_temu_app_key.description: app_key of your Temu Partner Platform app (issued after app review).

platform_mcp_temu_app_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TEMU_APP_SECRET
platform_mcp_temu_app_secret.description: app_secret of the same app; signs every call: upper(MD5(app_secret + sorted key+value of all body fields + app_secret)). Never sent on the wire.

platform_mcp_temu_access_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TEMU_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_temu_access_token.description: The store's access_token, issued when the seller authorises your app in Seller Center (manual authorisation copies it; 'can be obtained from Seller Center', Common Parameters). Check its expiry with `me` (result.expiredTime).

platform_mcp_temu_region.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TEMU_REGION
platform_mcp_temu_region.description: Gateway of the seller's store: us (United States), eu (Germany, Italy, France, Spain, UK, …) or global (Mexico, Japan, …) → https://openapi-b-{region}.temu.com/openapi/router ('Endpoints and Request Method', Developer Guide).

tools.name: me
tools.description: bg.open.accesstoken.info.get: the token's mallId, mallType (1 semi-managed, 100 local), expiredTime (epoch seconds) and apiScopeList (the APIs this token may call).

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: bg.order.list.v2.get: parent orders (PO-…) newest first, each with orderList[] (orderSn, goodsId, skuId, quantity, orderStatus) in `raw`. `status`: pending, unshipped (awaiting shipment), canceled, shipped, received or all. `since` (ISO date/datetime) filters by creation time (createAfter; createBefore is set far in the future because the API needs both). Parent status codes: 1 pending, 2 awaiting shipment, 3 canceled, 4 shipped, 5 received, 41 partially shipped, 51 partially received. `created_at` is epoch seconds; amounts come from bg.order.amount.query (not mapped).

tools.name: set_inventory
tools.description: bg.local.goods.stock.edit (local-mall stores): sets SKU `sku` (Temu skuId) of goods `listing_id` (goodsId) to exactly `quantity` (skuStockTargetList). Both ids are required and numeric; per-SKU results are in raw.skuStockEditStatusInfoList.
